<!-- pr-reviewer: e2f674ee307decb56b58159ebf5a7bb54f604154 -->
Needs changes before merge: add the required UI images. The local code checks passed.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutter_params.rs:58`, `tool_settings_grid.rs:149`, and `tool_summary.rs:84` change the dovetail controls. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add linked before/after images for the changed tool editor, Properties summary, and Draw cutter controls. Show the corner radius and the rounded cutter profile. Store the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to this PR branch. Use this evidence rule for each changed UI surface.

**Scope and code checks**

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects cutter geometry, gouge checks, stock simulation, and the post guard.

I read the complete diff and issue #4004. I used the current rules from `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.
The trial merge used upstream main `138a592a196a6c68e8608b560fbd2696977a71c7`.
Its local commit is `d9a511d9b3394ac0256d1cf2282a6fb8c1c4c2b8`. Its first parent is the PR head above.
The merge had no conflicts. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

The tests confirm the wider flank, the rounded bottom corner, neck validation, meridian agreement, and the post guard.
The sharp cutter posts. The cutters with `corner_r` values of 0.254 and 3.0 produce a gouge and hold the post.
The UI tests confirm that Apply stores the edited corner radius.

**Local build and test results**

`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 899 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
This includes five build steps and 894 test-suite steps.

| Crate | Suite steps | Tests passed | Tests failed | Tests ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| tools | 2 | 156 | 0 | 0 |
| sim | 79 | 820 | 0 | 3 |
| motion | 99 | 1412 | 0 | 70 |
| app | 705 | 4739 | 0 | 66 |
| ui | 9 | 1717 | 0 | 8 |

The UI lib suite ran from `crates/ui`: 1679 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
The quick gate took 67.4 minutes. The shared test helper caused the broad suite selection.

Clippy passed for `camcraft-tools`, `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app`, and `camcraft-ui`:
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

**Extra suites run**

These named suites ran within the quick gate:

- App `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed. `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- Motion `golden_undercut`: 4 passed.
- Sim `undercut_laws`: 16 passed. `verify_avoid_undercut`: 4 passed. `undercut_fixture_envelope`: 3 passed.
- App `mcp_slot_undercut`: 8 passed. `mcp_undercut_fixture`: 3 passed.
- App `stock_play`: 8 passed. `stock_play_partial`: 4 passed. `tool_gate`: 10 passed. `tool_law`: 7 passed.

The light lane also passed:
`cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light' --only 'app light'`.
This ran all five light test steps. Each step built its own target; I omitted the broad build-only step.
Motion lib: 7 passed. Motion `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, and `adaptive_troch_parallel`: 1 passed each.
App `pocket_pass_start`: 1 passed. Total: 11 passed, 0 failed.

The diff changes no fixture files or import code. The extra fixture-reader and kernel STEP rules do not apply.

**Mutations**

I compiled isolated copies of `field_dove.rs` and its segment-distance helper in `/tmp`.
I ran the two new SDF tests on each copy. The PR worktree stayed unchanged.

- Ignore the corner radius: both tests fail, as required.
- Restore the sharp flank in the rounded solid: both tests fail, as required.
- Unchanged control: both tests pass before and after the mutation checks.

**Goldens moved**

None. The diff changes no recorded NC or CL programs, catalog files, golden files, or snapshot PNGs.
The existing undercut goldens pass without an update.

Full heavy lanes and a physical mill were not exercised. No GitHub runner was used.

I left the labels, title, and draft state unchanged, as requested for this outside contributor's PR.
The review worktree and its branch remain in place for the next review.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand after the image evidence is complete.

Maintainer decision (question dialog, 2026-11-25): this PR is removed from the cut list of v0.27.0. His words: "Drop from release". It does not merge before the tag. Issue #4004 goes under "Known issues" in the release notes.

The review of head `e2f674ee3` found no code blocker. It asks for one thing: the before and after screenshots of the three changed tool screens (the tool editor, the Properties summary and the Draw cutter controls). Add them, and flag the PR ready. Then it gets a fresh review and merges after the tag.

Hi @paulsvc. This P1 is close: the code checks passed, and the only open item from the last review is the UI before/after images for the dovetail corner radius field.

To help it through, we are making those screenshots on our side with the off-screen renderer. They will go in a comment here shortly. When they are up, paste the table into the PR body (or tell us and we will), then mark the PR ready. A collaborator review of the same head then clears it. If you'd rather we finish the PR, say so: maintainer edits are allowed.

Addressed: the missing UI before/after screenshots (review of head `e2f674ee3`, item 1). No code changed. Nothing was pushed to the PR branch.

@paulsvc, thank you for the PR. We made the screenshots that the review asks for. They show the three changed surfaces for the same dovetail tool:

- Tool `DT-1905-60`: dovetail, Ø 19.05 mm, flank angle 60°, flutes 9.525 mm, shank Ø 8.0 mm, shank length 30.0 mm, `corner_r` = 1.0 mm.
- The world stores `corner_r` = 1.0 in both builds. Before the fix, the UI does not show it.

| Surface | Before (`baad348f1`) | After (`e2f674ee3`) |
|---|---|---|
| Properties summary | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/49847668c9153a8120102476b27bce0cd29660b2/4009/before-1-properties-summary.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/49847668c9153a8120102476b27bce0cd29660b2/4009/after-1-properties-summary.png) |
| Tool editor (Tool library window) | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/49847668c9153a8120102476b27bce0cd29660b2/4009/before-2-tool-editor.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/49847668c9153a8120102476b27bce0cd29660b2/4009/after-2-tool-editor.png) |
| Draw cutter (Tool shape, Profile tab) | ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/49847668c9153a8120102476b27bce0cd29660b2/4009/before-3-draw-cutter.png) | ![after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/49847668c9153a8120102476b27bce0cd29660b2/4009/after-3-draw-cutter.png) |

What the images show:

- Properties summary: after the fix, the "Corner radius 1.000 mm" row shows. The cutter preview draws the profile with the corner radius (a small round at the bottom edge).
- Tool editor: after the fix, the "Corner radius" field shows below "Flank angle (deg)".
- Draw cutter: after the fix, the "corner R" field shows (1.0). The profile table has arc points at the bottom corner (rows 3-6: 0.009 / 8.656, 0.034 / 8.784 ...). Before the fix, the profile has a sharp corner (row 2 to row 3: 9.525 to 4.026).

How we made them:

- Before = `baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0`, the merge base of this PR on upstream `main`.
- After = `e2f674ee307decb56b58159ebf5a7bb54f604154`, the PR head.
- One temporary test in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_undercut.rs` ran in each tree. It was not committed. It uses `egui_kittest` with the headless wgpu renderer (off-screen, no window), 1440 × 1100 px.
- The test adds the tool with `AddTool`, targets it, opens it in the tool library window, then opens Edit tool shape → Profile → Draw cutter. It saves one render at each step.
- The images are on the images-only branch `pr-screenshots` of `mkinney/Camcraft`, commit `49847668c`. The links use that commit sha, so they do not change.

Paste this table into the PR body under Screenshots (or tell us and we will), then mark the PR ready (Ready for review, or gh pr ready 4009). A collaborator review of the same head then clears it.
